name: dai-cgroup-probe2
command: exec > /out/cgroup-probe2.txt 2>&1; echo '== caps =='; grep Cap /proc/self/status; echo; echo '== try fresh cgroup2 mount inside container =='; mkdir -p /tmp/cg; (mount -t cgroup2 cgroup2 /tmp/cg 2>&1 && echo MOUNT_OK) || echo MOUNT_FAIL; mount | grep /tmp/cg; echo '-- listing:'; ls /tmp/cg 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo '-- mkdir:'; (mkdir /tmp/cg/dai-p && echo MKDIR_OK) || echo MKDIR_FAIL; (echo '+cpu +memory +pids' > /tmp/cg/dai-p/cgroup.subtree_control && echo SUBCTL_OK) || echo SUBCTL_FAIL; echo '-- move test:'; sleep 60 & SP=$!; sleep 1; (echo $SP > /tmp/cg/dai-p/cgroup.procs && echo MOVE_OK) || echo MOVE_FAIL; cat /tmp/cg/dai-p/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; rmdir /tmp/cg/dai-p 2>/dev/null; umount /tmp/cg 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '== controllers on fresh mount =='; cat /tmp/cg/cgroup.controllers 2>/dev/null; echo; echo done
